t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Check which of the gnomes gives more, they will always be in colour pairs. Eventually the amount you receive from the gnome which gives more mushrooms will drop, when this happens swap to the other colour

vb_textbox.text: the colour pairs will always appear the same, one of which will be higher, choose one and then the next time pick the other, continue choosing the higher of the wo, though this may change every 2-3 times so check often
